verdict.rationale: The Semgrep CLI runs scans locally without login (`semgrep scan`, `--dry-run`) and exports SARIF (`--sarif --sarif-output`). A hands-on report describes feeding Semgrep SARIF to LLMs to triage the most interesting findings, which matches the agent-parse-and-triage loop. Ticket creation is documented only as an AppSec Platform triage feature, and the API is described as listing findings, so issue filing would come from the agent's own tooling or the platform. Missing for 10: documented CLI or agent-driven issue filing, explicit JSON output and exit-code semantics for headless automation, and documented false-positive filtering in a headless CLI flow.
